title: Tablets detailing construction of the flood boat

tellings.quote: you read the ethic of humanity they're all in there and it's very detailed with like the amount of bitchin and the type of wood

plain: Ancient clay tablets from Mesopotamia, the old land between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, are said to describe in close detail how the boat that survived the great flood was built, down to how much pitch to use and what kind of wood. The researcher Matt LaCroix sums this up on Michels' show without naming a particular tablet, saying the detail is all there for anyone who reads them. He raises it as a sign that the flood story preserves a real memory.
